source: 751 “Help”
target: 751 “Auxilium”

source: Lumian had always assumed that the catacombs administrator, marked with light brown age spots, had been assimilated by the catacombs themselves, becoming part of this peculiar place, and would over time become more corpse-like, losing all semblance of life and forever sleeping within an upright, decaying coffin.
target: Lumian semper credebat administrator catacumbarum, qui maculis aetatis leviter fusco inscriptus erat, ab ipsis catacumbis absorptus esse, partem huius loci insueti factus, et tempore longiore cadaveri similis futurus, omnem speciem vitae amittens atque in sarcophago erecto putrescente in aeternum quiescendum.

source: Yet, here he was, able to leave the massive tomb chamber that housed the Samaritan Women’s Spring, still carrying a burning white candle.
target: Attamen hic aderat, capax exeundi a magno conclavi sepulcrali, in quo Fontem Samaritanarum Feminarum collocatum habebat, atque adhuc portans candelae albae ardentes.

source: Taking turns guarding the entrance to the Samaritan Women’s Spring, the longer you stay, the deeper the catacombs’ peculiar erosion takes hold, making you less and less like the living until finally, you no longer need a lit white candle to prevent being consumed by the catacombs?
target: Vicissim custodiendo ostium Fontis Samaritanarum Feminarum, quo diutius maneas, eo altior fit insueta erosio catacumbarum, quae te paene ex viventibus depauperat, donec tandem candela alba accensa non amplius opus sit, ne catacumbis absorberis?

source: Can one slowly recover once they rotate out?
target: Num aliquis paulatim se recuperare potest, postquam officia sua relinquitur?

source: Lumian speculated as he watched the elderly catacombs administrator ascend the steps.
target: Lumian speculabatur, dum senex administrator catacumbarum gradibus ascendebat.

source: As he drew closer and the candlelight illuminated his features, the group of students also got a clearer look at the newcomer.
target: Dum propius accessit et candela luce lineamenta eius illustrata erant, coetus studentium quoque novum advenientem clarius aspexit.

source: They recognized the uniform of the catacombs administrator but had never met one so aged he seemed nearly decomposed.
target: Illi uniformem administratoris catacumbarum agnovērunt, sed numquam convenierunt aliquem tam senem ut paene dissolutus videretur.

source: His face, speckled with light brown age spots and his eyes black and icy, coupled with his faint, almost non-existent breath, instilled an involuntary fear in them, prompting them to huddle together for warmth and courage.
target: Facies eius, in qua maculae aetatis leviter fusci sparsae erant, et oculi nigri atque glaciales, una cum spiritu vix perceptibili, in eos instinctivum timorem excitaverunt, impellentes ut ad calorem et fortitudinem se congregarent.

source: With each soft step echoing, the elderly caretaker stopped at the Entrance to the Old Ossuary.
target: Unusquisque lenis passus resonans, senex curator ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii stetit.

source: He then turned, casting his chilling gaze upon Lumian.
target: Tum se vertit atque oculos frigore pervadentes in Lumian immisit.

source: “I need to speak with you,” the catacombs administrator said in a hoarse, matter-of-fact tone.
target: “Tecum loqui mihi necesse est,” inquit administrator catacumbarum, voce rauca et sincera.

source: Me?
target: Me?

source: Do we know each other?
target: Nos num nos cognovimus?

source: Plus, I came here on a whim, driven by impulse and didn’t inform anyone of my plans.
target: Praeterea, casu huc veni, impulsu motus, nec cuiquam consilia mea nuntiavi.

source: Why would you need to see me?
target: Cur ergo me videre velis?

source: Lumian was taken aback, as were the university students.
target: Lumian, sicut discipuli universitatis, attonitus fuit.

source: They hadn’t expected this intriguing, skilled prankster to be acquainted with such a frightening catacombs administrator.
target: Illi non exspectaverunt hunc intrigantem et peritum ioculator, talem terribilem administrator catacumbarum iam cognitum esse.

source: Had he really explored the catacombs so often that he had befriended the administrators?
target: Num vere toties catacumbas perlustraret, ut administratoribus amicitia coniunxisset?

source: Perplexed, Lumian stood up and followed the elderly administrator to the side of the Entrance to the Old Ossuary.
target: Confusus, Lumian surrexit et senem administrator ad latus Introitus Veteris Ossuarii secutus est.

source: He wanted to hear what this was all about and why he was being sought out.
target: Volebat audire quid de hac re ageretur et cur ille peteretur.

source: In the dense darkness, with just a stub of a white candle making his face appear more ghastly, the emotionless caretaker said, “There’s been an anomaly with a corpse on the fourth level’s southwest corner. Handle it.”
target: In tenebris densis, cum solum truncus candelae albae faciem eius magis horribilem reddideret, curator, indifferens, dixit: “Anomalia accidit cum cadavero in angulo australi occidentali quarti gradus. Cura id.”

source: “Me?” Lumian pointed to himself with his empty right hand.
target: “Me?” inquit Lumian, se indicans manu dextro vacua.

source: Why are you asking me to deal with this? There are other catacombs administrators, official Beyonders for this sort of thing. Why me?
target: Cur rogas ut hoc curem? Sunt alii administratores catacumbarum, officiales “Beyonders” huiusmodi; cur me?

source: And you’re ordering me around as if I’m a mercenary paid to handle such matters, without even discussing compensation…
target: Et imperas mihi quasi mercenario, ad talia negotia solvendum mercede remunerato, sine de compensatione quidquam tractato…

source: “Correct.” The elderly administrator nodded gently. “My body and spirit are nearing decay, and I can no longer engage in combat.”
target: “Recte.” Senex administrator leniter annuit. “Corpus et animus mihi putrescentiae appropinquant, nec amplius in pugnam ingredi posse puto.”

source: Lumian eyed the administrator with curiosity, probing, “Do you know me?”
target: Lumian administratoris oculos cum curiositate intuebatur et interrogavit: “Me nosti?”

source: The deep wrinkles on the administrator’s face unfolded into a strange smile. “You are one of our kind.”
target: Profunda rugae in facie administratoris in risum mirabilem evolutae sunt. “Tu es unus ex nostris.”

source: One of our kind… Lumian mused, a guess forming in his mind.
target: “Unus ex nostris…” cogitavit Lumian, coniectura in mente formans.

source: “Deal with it now. The longer you wait, the more troublesome it becomes.” The administrator turned and headed back towards the “Entrance to the Old Ossuary.”
target: “Cura id nunc; quo diutius moraris, eo magis molestum fit.” Administrator se vertit et ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii rediit.

source: ! came to stake out Harrison from Resurrection Island, not to work for you… Lumian muttered silently, his curiosity piqued as he followed the more corpse-like than living administrator down the stone steps.
target: Non ad te laborandum, sed ad Harrison de Insula Resurrectionis inspiciendum veni—murmuravit Lumian silentio, curiositate excitatus, dum senex administrator, magis cadaverosus quam vivus, sub lapideis gradibus secutus est.

source: During this, he flashed a smile and waved at the students, frightening them into silence; none dared to respond.
target: Hoc interea, risum ostendit et discipulis manum ferebat, eos in silentium terrens; nemo audebat respondere.

source: Once Lumian and the elderly administrator’s figures had disappeared deep into the stone stairway, with only a flicker of candlelight remaining, the students finally relaxed and exhaled in relief.
target: Cum figurae Lumiani et senis administratoris in profunda scala lapidea evanuerant, et solum scintilla candelae remansisset, discipuli tandem relaxaverunt et leviter suspiraverunt.

source: That guy really knew the catacombs administrator well!
target: Ille vere bene administratorem catacumbarum noverat!

source: He must be extremely familiar with this place!
target: Oportet eum hunc locum eximie noverisse!

source: Were the rumors he shared actually true?
target: Num famae, quas divulgaverat, vere res fuerunt?

source: Recalling Lumian’s description of the dorm anomalies and the consequences of extinguishing a candle, the students shivered in unison, pulling their candles closer to their bodies.
target: Meminentes descriptionem Lumiani de anomaliis dormitoriis et consequentias candelae exstinguendi, discipuli una contremuerunt, suas candelas propius ad corpora trahentes.

source: Descending layer by layer, past François’ Tomb and the Blood Order Hall, Lumian followed the old administrator, quickly reaching the southwest corner of the catacombs’ fourth level.
target: Descendens stratum per stratum, praeter Sepulcrum Francois et Aulam Ordinis Sanguinis, Lumian veterem administrator sequebatur, celeriter ad angulum australi occidentalem quarti gradus catacumbarum perveniens.

source: Using the remaining third of his white candle, Lumian saw a giant skeleton, about three to four meters tall, composed of bones from different corpses and shaped like a human with seven or eight heads, all eye sockets dark, void of any colored flame.
target: Utendo reliquā tertiā parte candelae albae, Lumian ingentem sceleton vidit, circiter trium ad quattuor metrarum altitudinem, ex ossibus variarum cadaverum compositum, et in formam hominis cum septem vel octo capitibus versa, quorum omnes orbitae obscurae erant, sine aliqua flammā coloratā.

source: At that moment, the giant skeleton was opening tomb doors, extracting sharp bones, and adding them to its massive bone sword.
target: In illo momento, sceleton ingens portas sepulcrorum aperiebat, ossa acuta extrahens eaque ad suum ingentem gladium ossium addens.

source: The candlelight spread only slightly, illuminating the area minimally as darkness flowed like water, bringing an indescribable chill and horror.
target: Lumen candelae tantum parum diffundebatur, regionem vix illustrans, dum tenebrae, quasi aqua, fluere videbantur, afferentes frigorem et terror ineffabile.

source: Even without getting close, Lumian involuntarily felt fear and resistance, as if he were walking towards death.
target: Etiam abs non accessu proximo, Lumian involuntarie timorem et repugnantiam sensit, quasi ad mortem ambularet.

source: His blue eyes darkened to iron-black, reflecting the ghastly pallor of the aberrant skeleton.
target: Oculi eius caerulei in ferruginem obscurum mutaverunt, pallorem horrendum sceletonis aberrantis reflectentes.

source: Deep within its chest, it felt as if he had to cleave through layers of white bones to reach it.
target: In pectore eius profundo videbatur quasi necesse esset per stratas ossium alborum penetrare ut ad illum perveniret.

source: “You see it? Take care of it,” the old caretaker commanded again, as if ordering a subordinate.
target: “Videsne id? Cura id,” iterum praecepit senex curator, quasi subordinatum imperans.

source: “What abilities does it have?” Lumian wasn’t averse to lending a hand—he had just acquired a powerful item and was eager to use it, but he couldn’t just rush into battle without understanding the monster’s capabilities and planning his strategy.
target: “Quae facultates ei insunt?” inquit Lumian; auxilium ferre non recusabat—modo validam rem adeptus erat atque eam uti cupidus, sed in proelium impetu accurrere non poterat, nisi monstri facultates intellexerit et consilium paraverit.

source: The candle in the administrator’s hand was now just a stub, its dim flame stubbornly clinging on.
target: Candela in manu administratoris iam solum truncus erat, eius flamma obscura pertinaciter manens.

source: He shook his head and said, “I’m not sure, but it’s being suppressed by the catacombs, unable to show much of its potential. Once it gets dark outside, we might not have that advantage. We must clear it out now.”
target: Caput movit et dixit: “Nescio, sed catacumbae eam comprimunt, neque multum ex eius potentia ostendere possunt. Cum extra tenebra fient, fortasse hanc commoditatem non habebimus. Nunc id expurgandum est.”

source: The catacombs are suppressing it… Lumian mused aloud, “How often have these anomalies occurred recently? Is it frequent?”
target: Catacumbae id comprimunt… Lumian alte meditatus inquit: “Quoties hae anomaliae nuper evenere? Frequentesne sunt?”

source: “It’s normal, once or twice a month,” the elderly catacombs administrator replied in a raspy voice.
target: “Normaliter, semel vel bis in mense,” respondit senex administrator catacumbarum voce rauca.

source: Even if it’s broadly sealed, some abnormalities still occur? That’s similar to other areas of the Underground Trier…
target: Etiamsi late obsignata sit, quaedam anomalia tamen eveniunt? Id simile est aliis partibus Subterranei Trier.

source: As Lumian was about to ask more questions, the giant, mud-and-mold‑covered skeletal aberration seemed to notice them, suddenly turning around and raising its massive bone sword.
target: Dum Lumian plura quaerere parabat, ingens aberratio sceletonica, luto et fungo induta, eos animadvertit, subito se vertens et suum ingentem gladium ossium extollens.

source: The surface of the giant sword burst into pale‑white flames.
target: Superficies ingentis gladii in flammas pallido‑albas erupit.

source: Thud, thud, thud, the skeleton with several heads moved stiffly but quickly charged toward Lumian and the catacombs administrator.
target: Thud, thud, thud, sceleton cum pluribus capitibus rigide sed celeriter ad Lumian et administrator catacumbarum impetum fecit.

source: The surrounding darkness surged over, bringing with it a bone‑chilling cold and a terror that seemed to reach into their souls.
target: Tenebrae circumstantes impetu insurgentes, afferentes frigoris ossium perfrigidum atque terrorem, qui animis eorum penetrare videbatur.

source: Without hesitation, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and grasped the Sword of Courage.
target: Sine mora, Lumian in sacculum Viatoris inseruit et Gladium Fortitudinis arripuit.

source: A warm rush quickly spread through his body.
target: Calidus impetus celeriter per corpus eius diffusus est.

source: What’s there to fear?
target: Quid timendum est?

source: Fight, fight, fight!
target: Pugna, pugna, pugna!

source: Lumian drew the iron‑black greatsword and charged toward the giant skeleton and its terrifying bone sword.
target: Lumian gladium magnum ferri‑nigerrimum extraxit et ad ingentem sceleton ac eius terribilem gladium ossium impetum fecit.

source: Then, he swung the Sword of Courage upwards.
target: Tum Gladium Fortitudinis sursum intorquebat.

source: A bright white flame with a hint of blue burst forth from the blade.
target: Clara flamma alba, leviter caerulea insinuante, ex gladio erupta est.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: The iron‑black greatsword collided with the bone sword, made of numerous sharp bones, in midair.
target: Gladius magnum ferri‑nigerrimus cum gladio ossium, ex multis ossibus acutis composito, in medio aere concurrit.

source: Lumian’s knees bent as his feet sank into the mud.
target: Lumiani genua flecta sunt, dum pedes eius in lutum ceciderunt.

source: The skeleton’s force was immense, and the bright white‑blue flames tangled with the pale‑white flames, mutually extinguishing each other.
target: Vis sceletonis immensa erat, et flammae albae‑caeruleae clarae cum flammas pallido‑albas implicatae inter se extinguebantur.

source: Lumian was not afraid.
target: Lumian non timebat.

source: His eyes excited, he tightened his thighs, straightened his knees, and advanced rather than retreated, slashing with his iron‑black greatsword toward the colossal creature.
target: Oculi eius excitati erant; femora contraxit, genua recta tenuit, et progredi potius quam recedere incipiebat, gladium suum magnum ferri‑nigerrimum contra ingentem creaturam secans.

source: The bone sword responded with the force of a falling boulder.
target: Gladius ossium respondit cum vi lapidis cadentis.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: The collision triggered a violent explosion, and the fierce shockwave, carrying the bright white‑blue flames, struck the giant skeleton’s surface, pushing it back two steps.
target: Confluentia violentam explosionem excitavit, et impetu acerbo, flammis albae‑caeruleae illustrato, superficiem ingentis sceletonis percussit, duo gradus retro impellens.

source: Lumian pursued, slashing again with the Sword of Courage.
target: Lumian persequebatur, iterum Gladium Fortitudinis secans.

source: Rumble! Rumble! Rumble!
target: Rumble! Rumble! Rumble!

source: With each clash of the huge swords and in every massive explosion, a large number of bones fell from the skeleton, charred, and even the bone sword itself thinned significantly.
target: Cum omni concursu ingentium gladiorum et omni explosione maxima, magna multitudo ossium ex sceleton cecidit, combusta, atque etiam gladium ossium ipse significanter tenuatum est.

source: Finally, Lumian broke through its defense, cleaving into its chest with one strike.
target: Denique, Lumian eius defensionem fregit, in pectore uno ictu secans.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: The bright white‑blue fireball expanded there, penetrating its entire body.
target: Orbis ignis clarus, alba‑caeruleus, ibi expandit, totum corpus eius penetralia perveniens.

source: The giant skeleton froze instantly.
target: Sceleton ingens statim congelatus est.

source: Crash! t collapsed entirely, like a stacked block castle knocked over.
target: Crash! Totum corruit, sicut castellum ex lapidibus conpositum everruit.

source: Lumian withdrew his iron‑black greatsword, turned halfway to the elderly catacombs administrator, and smiled, saying, “Neutralized.”
target: Lumian gladium suum magnum ferri‑nigerrimum recepit, partim vertens ad senem administrator catacumbarum, et subridens dixit: “Neutralizatum.”

source: As he spoke, he returned the Sword of Courage to the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Dum loquebatur, Gladium Fortitudinis ad sacculum Viatoris reddidit.

source: Just after this action, Lumian suddenly sobered up.
target: Mox post hanc actionem, Lumian repente sobrius factus est.

source: Was that it?
target: Hocne fuit?

source: Although I had planned to engage in direct combat before drawing the sword, I hadn’t considered just a head-on attack…
target: Quamquam pugnare directe ante gladium sumendum consiliaveram, non meditatus eram tantum impetum frontale subire…

source: Truly the Sword of Courage…
target: Vere, Gladium Fortitudinis…

source: Hearing Lumian’s words, the elderly catacombs administrator, holding the nearly extinguished white candle, slowly approached.
target: Audiens verba Lumiani, senex administrator catacumbarum, candelae albae paene exstinctae tenens, lente accedebat.

source: Lumian, taking advantage of having just provided help, casually asked, “Has anyone visited the Samaritan Women’s Spring in the past few months?”
target: Lumian, modo auxilium praestito, leviter rogavit: “Num aliquis Fontem Samaritanarum Feminarum paucis mensibus praeteritis visitavit?”

source: That was supposedly the strongest point of death energy in the entire catacombs, and Harrison might be drawn there.
target: Illa dicebatur esse potentissima energiae mortis in totis catacumbis, et Harrison ibi fortasse attrahetur.

source: The elderly catacombs administrator looked at Lumian in slow motion, his voice hoarse as he said, “Extinguish the candle.”
target: Senex administrator catacumbarum, Luminum lente aspiciens, voce rauca dixit: “Extingue candela!”

source: What? Extinguish the candle? Are you trying to kill me? Lumian’s first reaction was that the catacombs administrator in front of him meant him harm.
target: Quid? Extingue candela! Mihi necares? Prima reactio Lumiani fuit, existimans administrator catacumbarum coram eo malum intendere.

source: Without a lit white candle here, one would be eerily erased and forgotten by all!
target: Sine candela alba accensa hic, quisque mirabiliter deleatur et ab omnibus obliviscatur!

source: At that moment, the candle in the administrator’s hand burned down to the end, flickered once, and was completely extinguished.
target: In illo momento, candela in manu administratoris usque ad finem combusta est, semel micavit, et penitus exstincta est.

source: Darkness surged toward the old man, seemingly engulfing him in deathly silence.
target: Tenebrae versus senem insurgent, eum in silentio mortifero quasi complectentes.

source: He did not disappear.
target: Non evanuit.

source: In that instant, Lumian recalled many things, including the catacombs administrator considering him one of their own and his own guess about it.
target: In illo instante, Lumian multa recordatus est, inter quae quod administrator catacumbarum eum unum ex suis habebat et suam ipsius coniecturam.

source: He hadn’t made his final, crazy decision when the darkness around the administrator viciously spread, enveloping him.
target: Non fecerat decisionem ultimam insanam, cum tenebrae circa administrator saevissime diffunderent se eum complectentes.

source: His white candle suddenly went out.
target: Candela alba eius subito exstincta est.
